_readme: Edit this file to change the portfolio. target_weight values are percentages and must sum to 100. To track a real account instead of the hypothetical model, add "shares" and "cost_basis_per_share" to each holding; when present they override the model inception calculation.

model.description: Hypothetical: $100,000 invested at target weights at the regular-session close on the inception date (or the next trading session if the inception date is not a trading day), then held without rebalancing.

rules.sector_limit_basis: Percent of the total equity sleeve, using look-through estimates for ETFs. The dashboard also shows each sector as a percent of the total portfolio.

benchmark.label: S&P 500
benchmark.note: SPY is an ETF used as a proxy for the S&P 500 index. Its returns differ from the index by its expense ratio and tracking difference.

sector_scheme.name: ICB-style sectors as published in Vanguard fund fact sheets
sector_scheme.note: Vanguard fact sheets use FTSE/ICB-style sector names (e.g., 'Technology' includes some companies GICS places in Communication Services, such as Alphabet and Meta). Individual stocks are mapped to the same scheme for consistency. Look-through figures are estimates.

holdings.name: Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF

sector_exposure.source: Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF fact sheet (F0970)

holdings.thesis: Owns ~3,500 US companies for 0.03%/yr, so the portfolio captures US market growth without stock-picking risk.
holdings.main_risk: Heavy weighting to large technology companies (about 41% of the fund) means a tech sell-off hits the core hard.

holdings.name: Vanguard FTSE Developed Markets ETF

sector_exposure.source: Vanguard FTSE Developed Markets ETF fact sheet (F0936)

holdings.thesis: Low-cost exposure to Japan, Europe, Canada, Korea and Australia diversifies away from US valuations and the dollar.
holdings.main_risk: Currency swings and slower developed-market growth can leave it lagging the US for years.

holdings.name: Vanguard Total Bond Market ETF

bond_profile.source: Vanguard Total Bond Market ETF fact sheet (F0928)

holdings.thesis: Investment-grade ballast (about 69% US government) that pays income and usually cushions equity drawdowns.
holdings.main_risk: Rising interest rates: with ~5.8-year duration, a 1-point rate rise implies roughly a 5–6% price decline.

holdings.name: Microsoft Corp.
holdings.thesis: Recurring cloud and software revenue with deep enterprise moats; Azure growth funds AI investment from cash flow.
holdings.main_risk: Heavy AI capital spending may not earn adequate returns; already large overlap with VTI's tech weight.
holdings.sizing_note: Held at 4% (below the 5% satellite norm) because VTI already carries large Microsoft and tech exposure.

holdings.name: Berkshire Hathaway Inc. Class B
holdings.thesis: Insurance float, railroads, energy and a large cash reserve give a conservatively financed, value-oriented compounder.
holdings.main_risk: Post-Buffett leadership transition and GEICO margin pressure could shrink the valuation premium.

holdings.name: Johnson & Johnson
holdings.thesis: Defensive pharma and med-tech leader with AAA-rated balance sheet and a long dividend-growth record.
holdings.main_risk: Talc litigation settlement could fail its 95% participation condition; drug-pricing policy pressure.

holdings.name: Procter & Gamble Co.
holdings.thesis: Everyday household brands with pricing power provide steady cash flow and a defensive anchor.
holdings.main_risk: Slowing volumes and private-label competition if consumers trade down; input-cost and tariff pressure.

holdings.name: NextEra Energy Inc.
holdings.thesis: Regulated Florida utility plus the largest US renewables developer, positioned for rising power demand.
holdings.main_risk: Execution and regulatory risk on the proposed all-stock Dominion Energy merger; rate-sensitive valuation and debt load.

holdings.name: Union Pacific Corp.
holdings.thesis: Irreplaceable western US rail network with industry-leading efficiency and strong pricing power.
holdings.main_risk: Norfolk Southern merger review runs into Q2 2027; conditions or rejection could disrupt the plan; freight is cyclical.

holdings.name: Shell plc (ADR)
holdings.thesis: Integrated energy major with LNG leadership, buybacks and dividends; adds international and inflation-hedge exposure.
holdings.main_risk: Oil and gas prices are volatile and geopolitically driven; energy-transition policy risk.
